audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gave Sett Level 1 and put Levels 4-5, First item and 2+ items at Skill, against the packet's Ambessa / Sett / Sett / Sett / Sett / Sett / Ambessa.
audit.why: whys[0] already says Level 1 favours Ambessa and whys[6] says she out-DPSes at two items; the tokens contradicted their own text in both layers simultaneously.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 3, 5 and 6 flipped as matched phases[N].side + win[N] pairs with ratings brought along; Levels 4-5 and First item awarded to Sett, Level 1 and 2+ items to Ambessa.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Repeating Dashes' is not an Ambessa ability. It was used as the tracked ability in tldr, winCon, enemyWin, loading, focus, breakdown.cooldowns, three phases, the do's and two report sections — the entire page was built on a fabricated name with no cooldown attached.
audit.why: Riot's names are Drakehound's Step (P), Cunning Sweep / Sundering Slam (Q), Repudiation (W), Lacerate (E) and Public Execution (R). Lacerate is 13/12/11/10/9s, Repudiation 18/17/16/15/14s, Public Execution 130/115/100s at 1250 range.
audit.corrected: Every instance replaced with the real ability and its rank-1 cooldown — Lacerate at 13s as the tracked dash, Repudiation at 18s as the shield to bait, Public Execution at 130s as her re-engage.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two claims were unsupported and three interactions were absent. Unsupported: 'Save your R The Show Stopper to suppress her mid-R'. Absent: Repudiation shields and then hits harder for what it blocked; Drakehound's Step dashes off any cast as an auto-reset; Public Execution carries healing that anti-heal answers.
audit.why: Riot's text for The Show Stopper says carry, slam, damage and a landing slow — no suppression, and the mirror audit removed the same claim. Repudiation's text says the slam deals increased damage if it blocked non-minion damage, which makes dumping punches into it actively bad.
audit.corrected: Suppression claim removed from spikes[1] and whys[4]; the Repudiation bait stated in dosFull[2] and breakdown.cooldowns; the Drakehound's Step reset tell stated in dontsFull[0].

audit.whatIsWrong: The itemization line justified Executioner's Calling with 'his healing out-paces your grit trades' — wrong pronoun, inherited from another matchup's template.
audit.why: Public Execution does carry healing, so the item is right; only the sentence was copied.
audit.corrected: Pronoun fixed and the healing tied to Public Execution.

edits.before: Dodge her dash chains — E-stun when her mobility is down. Sett wins by trading around Ambessa's Repeating Dashes and cashing the pattern: bait her mobility, then all-in.
edits.after: Dodge her Lacerate chains — Facebreaker her once the dash is spent. Sett wins by baiting Drakehound's Step and Repudiation out, then all-inning on the 13s Lacerate gap.

edits.before: Bait her mobility, then all-in. Track Repeating Dashes before every commit and keep the wave on your side.
edits.after: Bait Repudiation's shield out, then all-in. Track Lacerate — 13s at rank 1 — before every commit and hold the wave.

edits.before: Ambessa wins by landing Repeating Dashes, denying your pattern, and out-trading your engage windows.
edits.after: Ambessa wins by landing Public Execution, eating your burst on Repudiation, and out-dashing your engage windows.

edits.before: - Sett vs Ambessa - Track: Ambessa Repeating Dashes. - Keep the wave on your side. - Engage only on Repeating Dashes's cooldown. - Don't trade with an empty grit bar. - Ultimate = kill windows only.
edits.after: - Sett vs Ambessa - Track: Ambessa Lacerate and Repudiation. - Keep the wave on your side. - Engage on the 13s Lacerate gap. - Don't trade with an empty grit bar. - Ultimate = kill windows only.

edits.before: Double-punch passive makes you the strongest level-1 auto-trader in the lane. Punish Ambessa on every CS, but respect her opening tool — chips now, all-ins later.
edits.after: Drakehound's Step dashes her off every cast, so she opens and leaves before you swing back. Soak it on Pit Grit's missing-health regen and wait for Knuckle Down.

edits.before: Q gives move speed toward Ambessa and two empowered punches. Take short Q trades and back off before she can answer with Repeating Dashes.
edits.after: Knuckle Down's move speed and two empowered punches close her out. Trade short and leave before Lacerate, 13s at rank 1, is back for her.

edits.before: Facebreaker is online — the E-stun into double punch + W is your full pattern. Run it the moment Ambessa burns Repeating Dashes.
edits.after: Facebreaker is online at 16s — catch her as she dashes in, punch twice, then cash Haymaker. A one-sided pull only slows her.

edits.before: Q ranks make your punch trades heavier, but Ambessa has her core tools too. Keep the grit bar honest: trade in, W-shield her return damage, out.
edits.after: You keep her pinned: pull her into your minions so Facebreaker catches both sides and stuns instead of slowing, then cash the Grit she just gave you.

edits.before: Stridebreaker fixes your only weakness — sticking to Ambessa. Shove, recall on the spike, and force the next trade before she matches your item.
edits.after: Stridebreaker fixes sticking to Ambessa through Lacerate. Shove, recall on the spike, and force short trades in the window where she cannot dash out.

edits.before: Sterak's makes your all-in nearly unburstable. Fights are decided by whether you cash a max-grit W — track Repeating Dashes and commit on the gap.
edits.after: Two items and her dash chains plus Public Execution's 130s re-engage out-pace you. Hold Facebreaker for her step-in and never fight without it up.

edits.before: - Ambessa Repeating Dashes: matchup-defining — Her mobility. E-stun her when down. Track it before every engage. - Ambessa Lacerate: A dash strike that can recast — her core mobility + dodge tool. Dodge or sidestep it.
edits.after: - Ambessa Lacerate: matchup-defining — her dash and slow, 13s at rank 1. Step up the moment it is spent. - Ambessa Repudiation: an 18s shield that braces, then slams harder for whatever it blocked. Don't feed it punches.

edits.after: Track Ambessa's Lacerate dash before you commit

edits.before: Track Ambessa's Repeating Dashes: Her mobility. E-stun her when down. When it is down — E-stun + W her.
edits.after: Track Ambessa's Lacerate: her dash and slow, 13s at rank 1. When it is spent — Facebreaker, punch, Haymaker.

edits.before: Commit on Repeating Dashes's cooldown, on your level-6 spike, and on your Stridebreaker timing. Bait her answer first.
edits.after: Commit on the Lacerate gap, on your level-6 spike, and on your Stridebreaker timing. Bait Repudiation out of her first.

edits.before: Start Doran's Blade + Health Potion. Core: Stridebreaker  (stick to them through the W panel window), then Sterak's Gage; boots Plated Steelcaps. First back: Executioner's Calling (≈800g) — his healing out-paces your grit trades.
edits.after: Start Doran's Blade + Health Potion. Core: Stridebreaker (stick to her through the Haymaker window), then Sterak's Gage; boots Plated Steelcaps. First back: Executioner's Calling (≈800g) — Public Execution heals her through your chip.

edits.before: Her R Public Execution is a gap-close-plus-nuke ult that lets her re-engage after you think the trade is over. Save your R The Show Stopper to suppress her mid-R, or she'll dash-cancel your combo. Don't W blind -- she'll animation-cancel out of range.
edits.after: Her R Public Execution blinks 1250 units, suppresses you and slams -- it re-engages after you think the trade is over, and it's 130s at rank 1. Save The Show Stopper for that commit, and don't cast Haymaker blind: Drakehound's Step carries her out of it.

edits.before: At 6 you hold the edge by saving R to suppress her R re-engage.
edits.after: At 6 you hold the edge by saving R for her Public Execution commit.

notes: The whole entry tracked a fabricated ability called 'Repeating Dashes' — it appeared in the TL;DR, win condition, loading screen, focus panel, cooldown panel, three phases, the do's list and two report sections. Ambessa has no such ability. Everything is now keyed to Lacerate (13s), Repudiation (18s) and Public Execution (130s). I also removed the claim that The Show Stopper suppresses her mid-ultimate: Riot's text supports carry, slam, damage and a landing slow only.
